resources.string: Animated modes require actual multi-frame GIF/WebP source bytes and do not use a static preview fallback. Up to 300 frames, 2048 pixels per edge, 1 MP canvas, 64 MP total frame work, 120 seconds and 20 MiB output. GIF uses 216 colors, binary transparency and 10 ms timing units; cumulative timing is rounded without drift. WebP is lossless on Android 11+, high-quality lossy on Android 9–10. An unavailable host decoder or unsupported source reports failure, not first-frame success.
